description: Creates a new random email alias for the signed-in user that forwards to their inbox. Use when the user needs a private address for a website or service. The optional note describes where the alias is used. The optional domain must be one of the domains from list_alias_domains; without it the default alias domain is used. May return a plan-limit or rate-limit message instead of an alias.

domain.description: Optional alias domain from list_alias_domains, for example "relay.hidemail.app". Leave it out to use the default alias domain.

note.description: Optional short note saying where the alias will be used, for example "Netflix sign-up".

name: create_alias
title: Create alias
